body_en: Very clever people work hard for a long time. Talent helps, but practice builds real skill. Read about one scientist or artist and list three habits they kept. Copy one habit for a week: early start, careful notes, or daily review. Great work is often quiet work repeated.
body_zh: 很聪明的人也会长期努力。天赋有用，但练习造就真本领。读一位科学家或艺术家的故事，列出他们坚持的三个习惯。一周模仿一个习惯：早起、细心笔记或每日复习。伟大的工作常常是安静的重复。
